_doc: Root creatures (world-bible section 4) for the UE5 prototype. Our own design; the tier idea (Easy/Medium/Hard) is the only thing taken from shooter bots. Edit, then run unreal/scripts/run_bots.ps1 -SkipImport. Tier numbers are written into each placed bot by place_bots.py. Units: seconds, cm/s, cm, accuracy = chance a released lash lands (0..1). Positions: game metres (x east, y up, z south), converted by ov_units.py.
_canon: lash reach 4 m and a 0.6 s warning (Medium windup) from world-bible section 4; shock = a burst of damage pushes the roots back for a short time (rule 6).
